headline: TKO CEO Ari Emanuel: Paramount-WBD merger needed for the economy of Hollywood
summary: Ari Emanuel, WME Group executive chairman and TKO Group CEO and executive chairman, joins 'Squawk Box' to discuss why he's in favor of the Paramount-Warner Brothers merger. The deal remains on hold due to antitrust concerns.
